your_book:
Jaleel's book had a strong Monday, with the account sitting at $23,682.85 and an unrealized gain of $806.63 (+3.53% overall). The headline mover was RKLB (Rocket Lab), up a striking 8.44% today — but this is a name to scrutinize, not celebrate. It carries a −10.1% position-level loss, an AVOID verdict, and a QARP of just 43.3, meaning price has bounced while the fundamental thesis has been underwater for some time. At 14.9% of the book, it's the single largest weight, and that mismatch between size, verdict, and performance is the most pressing structural issue in the portfolio. Elsewhere, the software cluster did real work: NOW (+2.66%), SAP (+3.28%), and ADBE (+0.37%) all moved higher on a sector rotation trade as investors pivoted out of hardware/semis ahead of Microsoft earnings. NVDA added 2.93% and BSX rose 3.64%, though BSX's guidance slash from FY26 growth of 10.5% to 7–8.5% remains a live concern despite today's pop.

The drift zone is worth naming plainly. LULU bounced 4.04% today, but it's still down 3.3% in the position and carries a guidance-cut flag — five straight quarters of negative Americas comps, tariff margin pressure, and a stalled China business. A one-day pop doesn't fix that. SPGI is up 1.05% today on financial-sector tailwinds, but it too sits at a −3.4% position loss. Both HOLD-QUAL names — NVS (−1.59% today, −5.6% in the position) and GILD — are drifting, with MFN drug-pricing pressure a structural overhang for the whole pharma cluster including NBIX and VRTX.

What to watch: NVDA reports August 26 with export-control and AI-capex sentiment as the swing factor. LULU's next read is September 2. The RKLB size vs. verdict mismatch is not a watch item — it's a decision. Cash at $3.62 leaves no tactical buffer if any of the elevated-flag names deteriorate into their next earnings.

attention.headline: Largest holding carries AVOID verdict and a −10.1% loss
attention.note: At 14.9% of the book, RKLB is the biggest position yet holds the lowest QARP (43.3) and an AVOID verdict — today's 8.44% pop widens the gap between price action and thesis, making it a sizing decision that can't wait for another leg down.

attention.headline: Guidance-cut flag unresolved; today's bounce doesn't fix the thesis
attention.note: Five consecutive quarters of negative Americas comps, tariff margin damage, and a stalled China business underpin the elevated risk flag — next catalyst is September 2 and the position is still underwater at −3.3%.

attention.headline: STRONG BUY rating in conflict with slashed FY26 guidance
attention.note: Management guided flat growth through Q3 after cutting the FY26 growth target from 10.5% to 7–8.5%; today's 3.64% gain looks like noise against that fundamental deterioration, and the next update isn't until October 20.

attention.headline: Sliding on two fronts: down today and down in the position
attention.note: NVS fell 1.59% today and sits at a −5.6% position loss with an MFN drug-pricing overhang; at HOLD-QUAL with a QARP of 65.4, there is no strong fundamental reason to add, and the policy risk is ongoing.
